title: Three Bloodlines Converge as One
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment the three golden pillars shot into the sky, Chen Ji felt a gaze beyond mortal power descend from the depths of the celestial dome—the World-Destroying Eye of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was slowly opening.

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, killing intent pooling in his eyes like an abyss. He raised his head toward the heavens shrouded in dark clouds, and made a vow in his heart—the Heavenly Dao's Eye, one day he would crush it with his own hands. At this moment, the inner pages of the Tianji Record grew slightly warm, as if sensing the master's overwhelming hatred. "Chen Nian..." he murmured softly. His sister had been missing for years, yet never had she felt this close. The pull of bloodline trembled like silk threads at his heart, guiding him toward the altar hidden within the misty depths. Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, demonic path mists swirling around her, concealing the heavenly secrets of this forbidden ritual.

On the altar, the three pillars of light were already in position. Chen Nian wore a plain white sacrificial robe, her features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, though her brow carried a softer, more delicate quality. She gazed at her approaching brother, eyes slightly reddened, yet forced back her tears to offer a faint smile. "Brother, I'm late." Chen Ji closed the distance in three swift strides, stopping precisely one zhang away. The resonance of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key had yet to commence—premature approach would spell ritual disaster. He inhaled deeply, suppressing the churning emotions in his chest, his voice low yet resolute: "You're not late. From now on, none of us will ever be separated again."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice drifted from the mist's depths, carrying a hint of mockery: "Touching reunion scene. But Chen Ji, are you truly comfortable letting that old fox Ling Yuan watch from the sidelines?" Chen Ji curved his lips slightly, not turning back: "Since Sect Master Ling has honored us with his presence, I naturally must give him a clear show—the thing he has sought for so long will today be completely mine, right before his eyes." At the altar's edge, an elderly figure stood with hands clasped behind his back. Ling Yuan's expression was gloomy as water—the Tianji Record's aura was something he sensed most acutely, precisely the thing he had pursued for most of his life.

text.content: Ling Yuan's cold hum echoed through the night wind: "Arrogant. Blood resonance requires three bloodlines from the same source to proceed. Chen Nian may be your sister, but she still carries the Holy Sect's bloodline seal—do you truly believe you can succeed so easily?" Chen Ji finally turned around, his gaze calmly meeting Ling Yuan's. Those eyes held no anger, no provocation, only a detachment that had seen through everything. "Ling Yuan speaks truly." he said slowly. "Which is why I have already cleared away those superfluous bloodline seals for the Holy Sect." At these words, Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply. Ye Qing opportunistically tossed a black-as-ink token from the mist—it was the Holy Sect Holy Maiden's identity token, now discarded on the ground like trash.

dialogue.content: "You—" Ling Yuan's breathing quickened. "What have you done to Ye Qing?" Ye Qing laughed at the question, her voice cold as frost: "Ling Yuan, you're mistaken. Chen Ji didn't do anything to me. Quite the opposite—he gave me true freedom." She raised her wrist, revealing a shocking scar across it. "This is the chain the Holy Sect used to control me—the Bloodline Prohibition. Chen Ji deduced the breaking method using the Tianji Record, and with three thousand-year spiritual herbs as a catalyst, he removed this poison thorn for me." Ling Yuan's facial muscles twitched slightly. He was all too aware of how霸道 the Holy Sect's bloodline prohibition truly was—it was the very foundation that kept the Holy Maiden willing to serve the sect.

text.content: Chen Ji turned away from Ling Yuan, facing the altar's center. "Chen Nian, take your position." His voice was steady and commanding. "Ye Qing, expand the demonic mist fully—I need to completely sever the Tianji Record's connection to the outside world, including Ling Yuan's surveillance." Ye Qing nodded, forming seals with delicate hands as black mist surged outward like a tidal wave, enveloping the entire altar in moments. Ling Yuan attempted to probe with his spiritual sense, only to be gently yet inexorably pushed back. His face was ashen, forced to watch helplessly beyond the mist—Demonic Path Mist was an untransmitted secret of the Holy Sect, leaving even a veteran like him powerless.

choice.prompt: The blood resonance ceremony is about to begin, and Chen Ji must decide how to arrange the three participants' positions.

choices.text: Using Chen Ji as the central pivot.
choices.description: Positioning Chen Nian and Ye Qing on either side while he occupies the center to lead the resonance. This method demands the most from Chen Ji but offers the highest success rate for resonance.
choices.visible_reward: Resonance success rate increased by 30%, unlocking enhanced abilities.
choices.risk_hint: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate points, with severe consequences if failed.

text.content: Chen Ji walked slowly toward the altar's center, forming seals with both hands as the Tianji Record Fragment materialized in his palm. The three golden pillars began to vibrate subtly. Chen Nian and Ye Qing exchanged glances, each taking their predetermined positions. Beyond the mist, Ling Yuan's eyes blazed with fury, yet could only watch as this ritual that should never exist officially commenced.

"It's beginning." Chen Ji shouted low, three streams of bloodline power surging toward him like a breached dam. The fourth layer seal of the Tianji Record shook violently as countless ancient runes emerged like fireflies, weaving a magnificent golden net above the altar. Chen Nian's eyes finally grew moist—she could sense her brother's power resonating with hers, that long-missed familial bond piercing through ten years of separation to fuse perfectly in this moment.

choices.text: Positioning Chen Nian at the center.
choices.description: Making Chen Nian the core of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key to lead the resonance, with Chen Ji and Ye Qing providing support. This approach is safer but risks Chen Nian monopolizing the resonance's benefits.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains a chance for growth, deepening her bond with Chen Ji.

text.content: "Nian Nian, you lead." Chen Ji's voice was gentle yet resolute. "Your brother will protect you." Chen Nian hesitated for a moment, then nodded vigorously. She moved to the altar's center, and when her bloodline power began to surge, the Tianji Record's reaction was more intense than anticipated—because the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was fundamentally designed to be a vessel for heavenly secrets.

Chen Nian closed her eyes, raising both hands slowly. Chen Ji could feel his own bloodline responding, resonating, merging with his sister in an unimaginable way. Ye Qing spoke softly beside him: "Her soul's compatibility with the Tianji Record exceeds expectations... perhaps this is a script fate has long written." Chen Ji offered no response, merely standing quietly at his sister's side, prepared at any moment to shield her with his own body should unexpected circumstances arise.

choices.description: All three share the resonance pressure equally, with risks divided. This balanced approach reflects Chen Ji's philosophy of equality.
choices.visible_reward: The bond between the three deepens, forming a true bond of trust
choices.risk_hint: Resonance time extended, risk of exposure increased

text.content: "The three of us stand side by side and share the burden together." Chen Ji's voice was resolute. He extended his hands, holding Chen Nian with his left and Ye Qing with his right. The three hands overlapped at the center of the altar, and a strange power began to flow between the three—it was not simply spiritual energy resonance, but a deeper level of bond and trust.

Ling Yuan watched this scene outside the mist, a complex light flickering in his eyes. He had to admit that Chen Ji was more difficult to deal with than he had imagined—not only was his strength unfathomable, but he also possessed the terrifying ability to turn enemies into allies. For this kind of person, either eliminate him early, or never become his enemy. Unfortunately, he understood this truth too late.

The golden characters above the altar grew denser, transforming into flowing ribbons of light that encircled the three. Chen Ji felt the Heavenly Fate power within him surge like boiling magma, with every inch of his skin enduring unprecedented pressure. Yet he did not retreat. Instead, he proactively guided this force toward the Tianji Record. "Tianji Record, fourth layer seal... release!" he roared, his voice shaking the land for a hundred miles. The Tianji Record fragment suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light, as those characters sealed for ten thousand years finally revealed their true appearance—"Fate is not determined by heaven; the chess player can also be changed."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's voice trembled: "Brother, I see it... I see the true weakness of the Heavenly Eye!" Her eyes shimmered with golden light—that was the special state after the Heavenly Fate Lock Key activated. "It... it also needs to follow the rules it set! As long as we can find a possibility it cannot deduce, we can—" Before she could finish, the altar violently shook. Three beams of golden light shot skyward, piercing through the clouds! Ling Yuan outside the mist watched, his pupils constricting, for he sensed a power sufficient to threaten his life awakening. That was the complete form of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—a being that even Heaven itself had to show some wariness toward.

text.content: The golden light dissipated. Upon the altar, Chen Ji's aura underwent a dramatic transformation. Faint golden patterns swirled around him—marks left by the resonance between the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. The fourth layer seal's words carved themselves into his divine consciousness one by one, each character thundering through his understanding. He slowly opened his eyes, a flash of enlightenment flickering in the depths of his pupils—he had gained a brand new ability: 【Disaster Foreseeing】. From now on, all threats directed at him within five minutes would appear in his mind in advance, like an early warning of destiny.

choice.prompt: The complete form of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was activated, and Chen Ji gained a new ability. At this moment, facing Ling Yuan, how should he choose?

choices.description: While Ling Yuan was in shock, use the new ability 【Disaster Foreseeing】 to predict all his attacks and strike with overwhelming force. Let this old sect master thoroughly recognize the situation.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan lost his momentum on the spot, reputation greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: Exposing too much strength may attract greater attention

text.content: A faint smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth as his figure flashed, appearing before Ling Yuan. The old sect master instinctively wanted to retreat, only to find that an invisible force had already locked onto his qi. No matter which direction he moved, he would face devastating counterattack—this was the terror of 【Disaster Foreseeing】. "Sect Master Ling," Chen Ji's voice carried not a trace of emotion, "you chased the Tianji Record your whole life. Did you ever imagine its true master would be the waste you called me?"

Ling Yuan's face was deathly pale, yet he forced himself to maintain dignity: "Boy, you merely stumbled upon a fragment by chance. Do you truly believe you can oppose our Tianqing Sect?" Chen Ji chuckled softly. "Tianqing Sect? Sect Master Ling, do you still think you're the master of the Tianqing Sect?" His voice suddenly turned cold. "Three golden rays pierced the sky. Cultivators for a thousand miles know the Heavenly Fate Lock Key was fully activated at this moment. How many do you think will come to share a piece of the pie?" Ling Yuan's expression changed again. His previous arrogance instantly gave way to fear—the celestial phenomenon had attracted far too much attention. He now stood at the storm's center; one misstep away from utter destruction.

choices.description: Don't rush to attack. Instead, thoroughly crush Ling Yuan's psychological defenses with words. Let this old sect master collapse spiritually first.
choices.visible_cost: Give Ling Yuan time to react
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's mental defenses collapse, possibly revealing weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might make a desperate move

text.content: Chen Ji did not hurry to strike. Instead, he leisurely straightened his sleeves. "Sect Master Ling, grand-nephew has a question for you." The address made Ling Yuan's face turn livid—back then, Ling Yuan had used exactly these words to humiliate the newly entered Chen Ji. "When the Tianji Record abandoned you, what did you feel? Anger? Unwillingness? Or... fear?" Ling Yuan's pupils contracted violently. This question struck the deepest wound in his heart.

"Now, the thing you've chased your entire life is right in my hands." Chen Ji's voice was nonchalant, yet every word cut like a blade. "Do you want to know why I was chosen by the Tianji Record?" He paused. "Because the Tianji Record has never valued strength—it values temperament. You were too obsessed with obtaining, so you could never get it. And I..." he spread his hands open, his smile chillingly sinister, "I only wanted to make certain people pay the price. Coincidentally, the Tianji Record thought the same."

choices.text: Let him go从容放人，留作后手
choices.description: Though Ling Yuan is detestable, killing him now is too risky. Better to let him go—there will be more value to exploit later.
choices.visible_cost: Let the enemy before me go free
choices.visible_reward: Plant a seed of fear in Ling Yuan's heart, to be used in the future
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may seek revenge in the future

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew the imposing pressure locked on Ling Yuan, turned away without looking at him. 'Sect Master Ling, I don't wish to kill you today.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'Not because I dare not, but because there's no need.' Ling Yuan was stunned—he had imagined countless possibilities, but never once had he expected the other to let him go. Chen Ji continued: 'You have lived for several hundred years, you should know better than anyone—dead men can only hate, living men can fear.'

'From today onward, every time you see me, you'll remember today's humiliation. This kind of fear will torment you far worse than death.' Chen Ji finally turned his head back, giving Ling Yuan a meaningful smile. 'Of course, if you insist on seeking death, I won't mind sending you on your way. But right now, the Heavenly Fate Lock has been activated, and outside, many people will arrive soon. Are you sure you want to entanglement with me at this moment?' Ling Yuan shuddered all over—he could sense several powerful auras approaching from the distance—all experts drawn by the celestial phenomenon.

Ye Qing withdrew the Demonic Path mist, revealing a meaningful smile: 'Sect Master Ling, you should leave now. If you don't go soon, once those people arrive, you won't be able to leave.' Ling Yuan's expression changed repeatedly, finally turning into a cold snort. He stared deeply at Chen Ji—his eyes held resentment, unwillingness, and even a trace of fear he himself refused to acknowledge. 'Chen Ji, remember this!' After this hollow threat, his figure flickered and vanished into the night.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian whispered: 'Brother, are we really letting him go like this?' There was a hint of worry in her voice. Chen Ji reached out and rubbed his sister's head, his gaze fixed on the direction where Ling Yuan had disappeared: 'Nian Nian, remember one thing.' His voice was low. 'Mercy to an enemy is cruelty to yourself. But before that, you must make your enemy understand—he isn't even qualified to be your opponent.' Ye Qing nodded thoughtfully beside him. This person, Chen Ji, was more terrifying than she had imagined—not the terror of strength, but the composure of one who holds everything in the palm of his hand.

text.content: In the distant horizon, several streaks of light were rapidly approaching. Chen Ji frowned—the perception of [Huojin Xianjue] told him the arrivals meant no good. Two of the auras were extremely powerful, no less formidable than Ling Yuan. What was more troublesome was that among those auras, he sensed something familiar—a unique fluctuation belonging to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. 'The people from the Eye of Heavenly Dao have arrived.' His voice turned cold. 'Faster than I anticipated.' Ye Qing and Chen Nian both tensed; they knew the true test had just begun.

choice.prompt: The pursuers from the Eye of Heavenly Dao approach, Chen Ji must make a decision

choices.description: Since hiding won't work, might as well face the enemy head-on. Strike first while the people from the Eye of Heavenly Dao aren't fully prepared.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Repel the pursuers, deter the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He took a deep breath, the power of the Tianji Record surging within him. The characters from the fourth seal moved like living things around his body. 'Both of you, step back.' His voice was calm yet brooking no argument. 'Leave what comes next to me.' Ye Qing and Chen Nian exchanged a glance, then quietly retreated to the edge of the altar. They trusted Chen Ji, and more importantly, they trusted the power of the Tianji Record.

The streaks of light in the sky finally arrived above the altar. There were three in total. The leader wore a gray robe, his face obscured and indistinguishable, but the aura he radiated was as cold and abyssal as a deep sea. 'Chen Ji.' The gray-robed figure's voice carried no emotional波动 whatsoever. 'Hand over the Heavenly Fate Lock, and your life may be spared.' Chen Ji looked up at the figure, the corner of his mouth slowly curving: 'Spare my life? What bold words. Are you even qualified to say such things, merely a dog of the Eye of Heavenly Dao?'

choices.text: Temporarily avoid the edge, preserve strength
choices.description: The enemy's strength is unknown—it's unwise to fight head-on. Retreat first, settle accounts later. As long as the green mountains remain, there will be firewood to burn.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, counterattack in the future

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond to the gray-robed figure's threat. Instead, he quietly asked Ye Qing beside him: 'Can the Demonic Path mist be used again?' Ye Qing understood and nodded: 'Barely, but it won't last long.' Chen Ji made his decision without hesitation: 'That's enough. Take Chen Nian and go first. I'll cover the retreat.' Chen Nian was anxious: 'Brother, I'm not leaving!' Chen Ji turned back, his gaze tender yet firm: 'Nian Nian, listen to me. You're the core of the Heavenly Fate Lock. As long as you're safe, brother has nothing to worry about.'

Chen Nian wanted to protest, but was pulled by Ye Qing. 'Your brother is right.' Ye Qing's voice was low. 'He's the master of the Tianji Record—he has the ability to protect himself. But if you're captured, everything will be over.' Chen Nian bit her lip and finally nodded. The Demonic Path mist surged again, enveloping both of them. The gray-robed figure coldly snorted upon seeing this, raising his hand to pursue, but was blocked by Chen Ji. 'Want to chase them?' Chen Ji's smile was ice-cold. 'Ask my Tianji Record first.'

choices.description: Maneuver with the people from the Eye of Heavenly Dao, probe their true intentions, while secretly preparing a contingency plan.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence, laying the foundation for future schemes

text.content: Chen Ji did not strike immediately; instead, a playful smile spread across his face. "You said that surrendering the Heavenly Fate Lock Key would spare my life—is that true?" The gray-robed figure's aura flickered slightly, clearly not expecting a response. Chen Ji continued, "From what I know, the Eye of Heavenly Dao never makes a losing trade. Your personal appearance here indicates that this Heavenly Fate Lock Key is very important to you. How important? How much are you willing to pay for it?"

A tremor finally entered the gray-robed figure's voice: "You're probing me?" Chen Ji shrugged, looking indifferent: "Something like that. After all, being chosen by the Eye of Heavenly Dao is a blessing from three lifetimes for a waste of a disciple like me. I'm just curious—" His gaze suddenly turned sharp, "What exactly are you afraid of?" The gray-robed figure's pupils contracted slightly; this question's impact clearly exceeded expectations. In the Tianji Record, Chen Ji had seen clues—why the Eye of Heavenly Dao was so desperate to recover the Heavenly Fate Lock Key: because it feared a certain possibility.

In the间隙 of Chen Ji confronting the gray-robed figure, Ye Qing had already led Chen Nian beyond the altar's perimeter. The gray-robed figure clearly noticed this too, but he did not split his forces to pursue, seemingly viewing Chen Ji himself as the greater threat. "Chen Ji, you're very clever." The gray-robed figure's voice remained emotionless. "But clever people often die faster." Chen Ji smiled lightly: "Is that so? Then let's wait and see." He slowly raised his right hand, the power of the Tianji Record gathering into a point of golden light in his palm.

At this moment, a warning flashed through Chen Ji's mind—【Harming Machine First Sensing】 had caught a trace of fatal crisis. Behind the gray-robed figure, an extremely covert attack was taking shape—a gray glow invisible to the naked eye, moving at unimaginable speed, heading straight for Chen Ji's Brow Center. If struck, even with ten lives he wouldn't survive. But Chen Ji had already seen through everything; his body shifted slightly, and that gray glow grazed past his ear, carrying away a strand of broken hair. "Is that all?" he mocked. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao's methods are merely this much."

The gray-robed figure's aura finally changed; a solemn expression seemed to appear on that blurred face. "You... can foresee attacks?" For the first time, a tremor entered his voice. Chen Ji did not answer; his smile only deepened. He raised his left hand, the Tianji Record's radiance blazing brilliantly, and a stunning golden light shot from his fingertips straight toward the gray-robed figure's face. "Forewarning is merely for better counterattacks." His voice was ice-cold. "Since you've come, don't think of leaving." The golden light collided with the gray-robed figure's protective spiritual energy, erupting in a deafening roar. The ground around the altar shattered inch by inch; amidst the flying dust, two silhouettes crossed paths.

When the dust settled, the gray-robed figure's sleeve had been torn at a corner. He looked down at his wound, disbelief flickering in his eyes. "Impossible... You're merely a Foundation Building waste, how could you possibly injure me?" Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his robes fluttering gracefully, utterly unconcerned about the several bloodstains on his body. "Waste? Are you perhaps misunderstanding the meaning of that word?" His voice was calm, yet it thundered in the gray-robed figure's ears. "How could someone chosen by the Tianji Record possibly be a waste?"

At this moment, an overwhelming pressure suddenly descended from the depths of the heavens. Chen Ji looked up sharply, his pupils contracting—the aura did not belong to any cultivator; it was an overwhelming, absolute, irresistible force transcending human capability. Above the sky, a colossal eye was slowly opening, its pupil flowing with the radiance of the Great Dao's laws. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's true form was gazing at him. "Chen Ji..." An ancient and majestic voice echoed between heaven and earth. "You have greatly disappointed me." Chen Ji felt his blood nearly freezing, yet his gaze remained calm, even carrying a hint of provocation: "Disappointed? Shouldn't you be saying—afraid?"

The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil contracted slightly, and an apocalyptic aura suddenly pressed down. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically; the Eye of Heavenly Dao was suppressing him with the power of fate. Yet he clenched his teeth, forcibly enduring that pressure. The text from the fourth layer of the Tianji Record's seal surged madly within his body, and an unprecedented enlightenment flooded his mind—he saw it, saw the possibility of defeating the Eye of Heavenly Dao! "So that's how it is..." A smile slowly curved his lips. "You are not invincible. You have weaknesses, have possibilities you cannot deduce." He raised his head, directly facing that colossal celestial eye. "And I, will find that possibility."
